# Profile widgets

Each optional section has `BEGIN` and `END` comments in README.md so it can be removed independently.

| Section | Project | Updates |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Typing animation | [DenverCoder1/readme-typing-svg](https://github.com/DenverCoder1/readme-typing-svg) | Generated by the image service |
| Activity graph | [Ashutosh00710/github-readme-activity-graph](https://github.com/Ashutosh00710/github-readme-activity-graph) | `activity-graph.yml`, daily |
| 3D contributions | [yoshi389111/github-profile-3d-contrib](https://github.com/yoshi389111/github-profile-3d-contrib) | `profile-3d.yml`, daily |
| Metrics dashboard | [lowlighter/metrics](https://github.com/lowlighter/metrics) | `metrics.yml`, daily |

Push the workflow files to `main` to trigger the initial generation. The workflows can also be run from GitHub's Actions tab. The activity graph is generated inside the workflow because the project's public Vercel endpoint returned HTTP 402 during setup.

The activity graph and initial 3D calendars use snapshots of your public GitHub contributions. The first `Generate 3D contributions` run adds the project's full language and contribution statistics. The local preview labels the official Metrics examples as sample data; the README uses waiting cards until your Metrics token is configured.

## Metrics token

Metrics needs a personal token for reading account-level data; its documentation says the automatic repository-scoped `GITHUB_TOKEN` is insufficient. Create a token for public profile data using the [official setup guide](https://github.com/lowlighter/metrics/blob/latest/.github/readme/partials/documentation/setup/action.md), and save it in this repository's Actions secrets as `METRICS_TOKEN`. Do not paste the token into README.md or a workflow file.

The workflow uses `METRICS_TOKEN` to read data and the automatic `GITHUB_TOKEN` to save generated SVG files. If the secret has not been configured, the Metrics steps are skipped with a notice. After adding the secret, run `Generate Metrics dashboard` manually for the first render.

To remove a widget, remove its marked README section and corresponding workflow. The typing animation has no workflow.
